lines.text: Marcus books Glacier for June tenth, with Going-to-the-Sun Road as the big day.
He learns the high part of the road is plowed every spring, and usually opens between mid-June and early July.
For the whole road and most trails, go mid-July to mid-September.
If June is your only week, plan Lake McDonald, Avalanche Lake and Many Glacier instead.
Save this before you book Glacier.
